# Michael Nowakowski

> Senior software engineer - developer platforms, creative tools, and
> content-creation pipelines. 8+ years across VFX/animation studios and platform
> engineering. Based in Seattle, WA.

This site (nowakowski-studios.com) is Michael's personal site: a brief bio, his
professional work and resume, and creative projects (software, photography, and
video). For the most detailed, machine-readable account of his work history, use
the long-form resume below.

## Work / resume
- [Work](https://nowakowski-studios.com/work.html): resume page - experience,
  skills, talks, and education (mirrors the PDF).
- [Long-form resume](https://nowakowski-studios.com/resume-long.md): fuller,
  machine-generated work-history summary (roles, projects, metrics). More detail
  than any page on the site.
- [Resume PDF](https://nowakowski-studios.com/files/michael-nowakowski-resume.pdf): downloadable one-page resume.

## Creative projects
- [Software](https://nowakowski-studios.com/software.html): creative coding, imaging experiments, and personal tools.
- [Photos](https://nowakowski-studios.com/photos.html): photography (places, portraits, illustrative, performance).
- [Videos](https://nowakowski-studios.com/videos.html): film and video work.
